claims.statement: Production runs as Docker Compose on a single 2 vCPU / 4 GB DigitalOcean droplet; deploys are manual from a developer Mac over SSH with ControlMaster multiplexing, and there is no CI deploy to production.

Two web replicas (web-blue, web-green) share an identical image; the active color is tracked in /opt/vfic/ACTIVE_COLOR and Caddy routes only to web-<active>:8000 via a Caddyfile regenerated from backend/Caddyfile.template by scripts/flip_caddy.sh.
Deploys pin to franknguyenvd/vfic-backend:<git-sha>; latest is a registry convenience tag and is never used by make deploy.

The blue/green sequence (pull → alembic → start inactive color → healthcheck → smoke_turn → flip Caddy → record PREV_COLOR/PREV_TAG → stop old color) never flips Caddy until scripts/smoke_turn passes; a failed smoke gate aborts before the public cutover.
The inactive color is stopped but kept on disk so make rollback revives it instantly without rebuilding; bg_rollback.sh reads PREV_COLOR and PREV_TAG and flips Caddy back in seconds.
Worker replica counts are intentional: worker-chatbot ×2 on the webhook_high queue, worker-persistence ×1 isolated on persistence_low, worker-ingest/worker-followup/scheduler ×1 each.

make release-check runs alembic heads == 1, backend ruff + pytest (unit + integration smoke), frontend lint + typecheck + unit + coverage + build + e2e desktop + e2e mobile, and a RAG golden-set benchmark via scripts/release_gate_check.py; any failure aborts make deploy.

Caddy edge sets HSTS max-age=31536000, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, encodes with zstd gzip, and uses flush_interval -1 on /realtime/* so SSE events flush immediately.
